description: Fractal Pokédex Ordinals is a collection of 1,025 unique Pokémon NFTs inscribed on the Fractal Bitcoin blockchain. Each token represents a different Pokémon, from Bulbasaur (#1) to Pecharunt (#1025), and includes its illustration, name, and key characteristics such as types, abilities, and battle statistics. Every Pokémon is linked to a unique on-chain inscription, making its image, metadata, and inscription ID individually verifiable. The collection brings together the iconic world of Pokémon, digital collecting, and Bitcoin inscription technology in a complete series of 1,025 tokens.
name: Fractal Pokédex Ordinals
